For the Opposite Party/s : Mr.Sadanand Paswan  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE ARVIND SRIVASTAVA  ORAL ORDER 5 19-05-2023 Heard learned counsel for the petitioners and learned counsel for the State.

Petitioners apprehend arrest in connection with Kusheshwar Asthan P.S. Case No. 92 of 2021 registered for the offence under sections 376/34 of the Indian Penal Code, sections 4 and 6 of the POCSO Act, section 67B of the I.T. Act and section 3(2)(v) of the SC/ST (POA) Act.

Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioners have not committed any offence as alleged in the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.33775 of 2023(5) dt.19-05-2023 first information report and they have been falsely implicated in this case.

As a matter of fact, the police after investigation has submitted final form finding no evidence against these petitioners, as is evident Dev Kumar Ray @ Deva Roy @ Dev Kumar vs The State Of Bihar on 19 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/99161428/
1 from Annexure-2.

Case No. 92 of 2021 subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
